gbm_population_evidence.quote: colorectal, gastric, non-small cell lung, renal cell, breast, hepatocellular, ovarian, cervical cancer, GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: A monoclonal antibody that binds to CD93, DCBY02 will be administered as a single intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 in each 21-day cycle.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The malignancy must have progressed after at least 1 available standard therapy for incurable disease

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters of DCBY02: maximum observed concentration (Cmax)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: characterize PK and PD of DCBY02
agree to have a fresh biopsy at Screening and an on-treatment biopsy

role_evidence.quote: to assess the effects of anti-CD93 mAb (DCBY02) as a monotherapy in patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; GBM is named in the inclusion criteria, so basket_gbm_eligible. The two registered arms are dose escalation and dose expansion of the same single agent, treated as a single-arm design for control_arm_from_other_arms. PK parameters are listed but the sampling matrix is not stated (plasma is likely but not written), so tumour_pk_planned is unclear. PD is mentioned in the Part 2 arm text and an on-treatment biopsy is required, but no specific pharmacodynamic measurement linked to CD93 is stated, so target_engagement_planned is unclear. Hypoxia is mentioned only as a rationale, not as a biomarker.
